messages:
sophia: Kicked off the A/B run for the int4-bridge model on prod slices. Shadow was clean, now doing 5% traffic ramp to variant B. Observing baseline metrics now.

kevin: Nice. What are the guardrails for auto-fallback this time? Last time the MRR jitter caused a noisy rollback.

ranjit: We're using a combo: absolute MRR drop > 1.5% over 30m window OR relative AUC drop > 0.8% plus p95 latency increase > 12%. Also require 3 consecutive evaluation windows. See snippet:

```
rollout:
  variant: int4-bridge-v1
  ramp: 5%
  auto_fallback:
    - metric: mrr
      comparator: absolute
      threshold: -1.5
      window_minutes: 30
      consecutive_windows: 3
    - metric: latency_p95_ms
      comparator: relative
      threshold: 12
      window_minutes: 30
      consecutive_windows: 3
```

sophia: We're also gating on hallucination rate on the doc-summarization slice — >= 0.5% increase triggers hold only (no immediate rollback) so we can triage.

maria: Question: are we using prefetched KV cache for B? That can change cold-start tail.

kevin: Yes. B warms KV for longdocs at 95th percentile during shadow. We added a synthetic warmup step to match cache hit patterns.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout/int4-bridge-v1 -> shadow->5% at 1769995000

alex: Early telemetry: MRR delta = -0.6% (within safe), latency p95 delta = +8% (below 12%), hallucination +0.2%. Will keep monitoring.

ranjit: If we see MRR decline drift to -1.8% but latency small, we let rule 1 fire and rollback. We'll alert on any >=1% sustained drop so oncall can inspect.

sophia: Plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 6 hours if all gates pass. If any gate trips, automatic rollback + notify #eng-oncall + postmortem template auto-created.

kevin: Can someone add the promote-to-dedicated guard? We don't want int4 at dedicated until 24h stability.

maria: Added note in rollout config: `min_stable_hours: 24` for dedicated promotion. Also added `safety_fence: true` for enterprise customers.

ranjit: Good. If we need to tweak thresholds mid-run we'll coordinate in this thread. Ping me for quick toggles.

sophia: Thanks team — updating the rollout doc with today's thresholds and saving a snapshot of evaluation queries. Will post results after 3rd window.
